status: completed conditional joint Wang and Salt Table III fit
interpretation: Exploratory, nonblinded conditional calibration. Salt outcomes were previously inspected; this is not independent validation or a matched acoustic prediction.

provenance.salt_citation: Salt AN, Konishi T. Effects of noise on cochlear potentials and endolymph potassium concentration recorded with potassium-selective electrodes. Hearing Research. 1979;1:343-363. doi:10.1016/0378-5955(79)90005-4.
provenance.salt_table_definition: ΔEPo is the difference between pre-exposure EP and EP measured after exposure under quiet conditions; Table III values are mean ± standard deviation, with n identified as observations.

candidate.frozen_status: user-authorized exploratory reference candidate evaluation freeze
candidate.hybrid_closure: U_C, U_M, marginal K half-saturation (4 mM) and intact basal paracellular leak adapted from related 19-state C model commit 64ae8344e45dcb45b8b9d2bc9fb0528cd6876aac; not specified in manuscript.
candidate.drug_source: All six existing drug-proxy/calibration values loaded from the validated freeze; not varied in this fit.

salt_source_data.excluded_outcomes: Only ΔEPo overall per-exposure changes were fitted. ΔEPc, ΔEPon-off, ΔEPq, CM/SP/AP, potassium concentrations, and separate second-turn rows were not included. The separate second-turn 115-dBA group is not pooled with the basal-turn target because the spatially lumped model has no turn-specific observation operator; correlated Table III components were not counted as additional targets.
salt_source_data.repeat_measures: Exposure numbers 1-3 are retained as repeated outcomes. The paper reports n observations per row (3, 3, 3 at 95/105 dBA; 9, 9, 7 at 115 dBA), but provides no within-subject covariance. Repeated rows are therefore not treated as independent likelihood samples.

central_scenario.name: primary_same_numeric_level
central_scenario.interpretation: Conditionally assign each dBA number to the same numerical dB SPL value. This is an illustrative fixed input assumption, not a conversion.

alternate_scenarios.name: alternate_minus_10_db
alternate_scenarios.interpretation: Illustrative fixed -10 dB offset from the same-number mapping; not a justified conversion, correction, or uncertainty bound.

alternate_scenarios.name: alternate_plus_10_db
alternate_scenarios.interpretation: Illustrative fixed +10 dB offset from the same-number mapping; not a justified conversion, correction, or uncertainty bound.

conditional_acoustic_input.interpretation: The existing model expects a dB SPL-like input to its empirical broadband transform. No unique mapping from the paper's dBA open-bulla stimulus to dB SPL or model drive was identified. The central same-number mapping and ±10 dB offsets are fixed illustrative scenarios, not conversions, justified corrections, or uncertainty bounds. Alternates are predictions with the central fitted parameters.

observation_protocol.source_protocol: NIH-strain guinea pigs (350-550 g) were anesthetized throughout recording and exposure (pentobarbital 30-35 mg/kg, gallamine immobilization, artificial respiration). Filtered broadband white noise (approximately 400 Hz-8 kHz) was delivered to the open bulla for repeated 20-minute periods, at levels including 95, 105, and 115 dBA. EP was recorded from basal-turn scala media. Measurements of auditory-response input-output functions started 1 minute after noise offset and took approximately 2 minutes; this does not specify the timing of Table III EP summaries. Quiet intervals were usually 5 minutes, sometimes 10.

model_schedule.temporal_operator: For each exposure, trapezoidal mean of model EP at 1, 2, and 3 min after offset, minus model EP immediately before that exposure. This is a hypothetical EP observation operator, not a source-established Table III measurement window.

observation_protocol.model_observation: reference state y[8], EP in mV.

weighting.objective: Existing Wang 1992 and Wang 1990 residual definitions/scales are unchanged. Salt residuals are (predicted ΔEPo - Table III mean) / (3 mV × sqrt(3 episodes)); sum of squares is therefore equally weighted per Salt level, with the three repeated episodes sharing one level's total weight.

alternate_fixed_parameter_predictions.name: alternate_minus_10_db
alternate_fixed_parameter_predictions.interpretation: Illustrative fixed -10 dB offset from the same-number mapping; not a justified conversion, correction, or uncertainty bound.

alternate_fixed_parameter_predictions.name: alternate_plus_10_db
alternate_fixed_parameter_predictions.interpretation: Illustrative fixed +10 dB offset from the same-number mapping; not a justified conversion, correction, or uncertainty bound.

drug_recheck.interpretation: Existing drug objective reevaluated after changing only the three sound parameters; six frozen drug parameters remain fixed.

limitations: The table gives group mean ± SD and observation counts but no within-animal or cross-episode covariance; repeated rows and Table III components are correlated. The deterministic equal-level weighting is not a likelihood and does not infer a covariance.
The central dBA-to-dB-SPL numerical mapping and ±10 dB alternatives are unsupported illustrative assumptions; they are not acoustic conversions, corrections, or uncertainty bounds.
The primary 95-dBA-to-95-dB-SPL assumption lies below the 105-125 dB SPL Wang calibration levels; its model transform input is not directly constrained by the fitted Wang range.
The model is a spatially lumped guinea-pig cochlear reconstruction, not a matched basal-turn electrode/acoustic-field model; species/preparation and output measurement processes remain simplified.

The 5-min quiet gap is the reported usual interval; some experiments used 10 min. The 1–3-min auditory-response measurement window does not establish when Table III EP was measured. Averaging EP over that window is a hypothetical, unverified observation operator.
The table's n is number of observations, not necessarily independent animals; n and SD are preserved but not used to imply independent residual precision.
Only basal-turn ΔEPo was fit; the separate second-turn 115-dBA group was excluded because the lumped model cannot resolve turn-specific EP, and correlated EP components were excluded.

The frozen candidate was outcome-informed and Salt was previously inspected, so this is nonblinded recalibration, not independent validation. The candidate freeze file, model source, previous fitted result, and figure are not modified.
The model uses a related-code hybrid closure absent from the manuscript; sound parameters have numerical bounds and a local optimizer does not establish a global optimum or identify mechanism.
The nominal frozen initial state is not exactly stationary, though Salt per-episode changes use the immediate pre-exposure EP and therefore report episode-local change.
